methodology.trackedSource: Working tree uses index paths, including staged additions, excluding untracked files; git refs use their own tree.
methodology.explicitlyDisabled: Only disabled=true on counted nodes, not inherited group disablement; all count toward total.
methodology.conditionsAndActions: All entries of every conditions/actions array encountered recursively, including comment and script entries; no filtering by enabled state.
methodology.authoredTypeScript: Tracked Zombiehood/scripts/**/*.ts, including local .d.ts; excludes Zombiehood/scripts/ts-defs/ entirely.
methodology.physicalLines: Blank and comment lines count. LF, CRLF and CR delimit lines; count a final unterminated line once, no phantom line after a final terminator; empty file = 0.
methodology.dirty: Working tree: any repository staged/unstaged change or nonignored untracked file; ref snapshots: false. Untracked files never contribute metrics.
